insight.headline: Discover a merchant's retail stores with UCP location search and lookup
insight.what_changed: Shopify storefronts now support the UCP location capability, dev.ucp.common.location.search and dev.ucp.common.location.lookup, starting with UCP 2026-08-25. When you negotiate these capabilities over the storefront MCP endpoint, your agent can find a merchant's physical stores, narrow them by name, city, or distance, and check which stores carry the items a buyer wants.
